outcome: Third and fourth degree perineal tears
cohort: Participants were mothers who underwent operative vaginal deliveries (forceps or ventouse) at R.G KarMedical College, Kolkata, West Bengal, India, between 2020 and 2022.
finding: Ventouse delivery was associated with lesser maternal trauma but was accompanied by increased fetal complications like cephalhematoma and severe jaundice compared to forceps delivery.
mod_finding: Forceps delivery resulted in more third and fourth-degree perineal tears and traumatic PPH, while ventouse delivery led to less maternal trauma but more fetal complications like cephalhematoma and severe jaundice.
